title: Free Movie from Fandango!
description: We've dug up an awesome new deal for today! Deals end quickly, so be sure to subscribe!  Today's Deal: Free 4k Movie for Sprint Customers on FandangoNow  Please note: some of the links below may contain affiliate links, meaning, at no additional cost to you, we may earn a commission if you click through and make a purchase.    - Sprint Rewards App: https://bit.ly/2T5GnuT - FandangoNow: https://bit.ly/28SKShA - FandangoNow Review: https://bit.ly/2ICoNtw   - Sprint 1-Year Deal: https://sprint.co/2H2VHBg

asr.full_text: What's up, dingoes and dingas? If you're a Sprint customer and you love to watch movies, we have an awesome deal for you today from Fandango Now. Let's get digging. Today's deal is for a free 4K movie directly from Fandango Now. Fandango Now is Fandango's online movie streaming service which competes directly with Netflix, Amazon Prime, and Hulu. Now, if you've never heard of Fandango now, you're not the only one. I was actually shocked to learn that this service has been around for over two years,. And it seems that the few people that are using this service strongly dislike it. However, there ain't no better deal than free, so let's go ahead and try it out. Now, as mentioned before, you must be a Sprint customer in order to claim this deal. If you're not currently a Sprint customer, I will include additional details about a. Separate deal down below. This deal will give you a free year of service from Sprint with unlimited talk, text, and. Data if you switch from Verizon or AT&T. Again, this is a separate deal, so I'll include information down in the description. If you are currently a Sprint customer, all you have to do is download the My Sprint Rewards. App on your Android or iOS device. In addition to these steps, you will also need to create an account on Fandango now. In which you will need to input the promo code from the My Sprint Rewards app. And that's pretty much it. Now I will also include one of the few reviews I could find on Fandango now down in the description. That's pretty much all we have for you today. As always I will leave all relevant links down in the description. If you have any questions feel free to let me know. And don't forget to subscribe because deals don't last long. Have a great night.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents and reviews a conditional FandangoNow promotion for a free 4K movie, including the stated steps for using My Sprint Rewards, creating a FandangoNow account, and entering a promo code. The visuals described are consistent with ordinary commerce and service promotion. The affiliate disclosure and subscription request are presented as ordinary audience engagement, and the Sprint promotion is described as a separate deal rather than a deceptive mechanism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer is a free movie available under a stated Sprint-customer condition, with the speaker describing app, account, and promo-code steps to claim it.
